items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I get a call from Howard Rumsey... He said, “No you’re not, you’re coming out here to The Lighthouse. You’re going to work here.”

ctx.x: Anyway, she was fine. We had the baby and everything, but I stayed in the South Bend, Indiana area. And after that I was contemplating going to New York and just seeing what would happen. Work around New York, maybe try to get in the studios and do jazz clubs. And I get a call from Howard Rumsey, who worked at The Lighthouse in Hermosa Beach, one of the first jazz joints in the whole country. And he asked me what I was going to do. I said well I’m getting ready to go to New York. He said, “No you’re not, you’re…
Yeah, your name is definitely associated with the west coast.
